verdict.rationale: An email marketing SaaS like Moosend could plausibly publish an interactive API reference, so this story applies. However, the evidence pack contains no mention of an API reference, a developer portal, or runnable examples. The only integration evidence is a no-code app-connection claim, which is a different feature from an interactive API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
